title: WGS84 Gravity Model
text: Implement 1984 World Geodetic System (WGS84) representation of Earth’s gravity, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Month} sets Month; {Type of gravity model} sets the gravity model method WGS84, {Units}, {Exclude Earth’s atmosphere} sets the earth atmosphere, {Precessing reference frame}, {Input Julian date}, {Day}, {Year}, {No centrifugal effects} sets the centrifugal effects and {Action for out-of-range input} sets the out-of-range block behavior. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: μ l h
ports.summary: Position in geodetic latitude, longitude, and altitude three-element vector | M -by-3 array

ports.name: JD
ports.summary: Julian date scalar | value greater than 2451545

params.name: Type of gravity model
params.values: Gravity model method WGS84 Taylor Series (default) | WGS84 Close Approximation | WGS84 Exact

params.name: Month
params.values: Month January (default) | February | March | April | May | June | July | August | September | October | November | December

params.name: Action for out-of-range input
params.values: Out-of-range block behavior Warning (default) | Error | None
